page.overview:
What is 99% Invisible?

99% Invisible is a radio show and podcast produced and created by Roman Mars that focuses on design.

It began as a collaborative project between San Francisco public radio station KALW and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco. PRX has distributed the show for broadcasting on a number of radio stations and as a podcast on the Radiotopia network. On April 28, 2021, Roman Mars announced in an introduction of a re-released episode that 99% Invisible had been purchased by SiriusXM and marketed as part of its Stitcher Radio brand.

The name of the show was derived from a quote by Buckminster Fuller that, "Ninety-nine percent of who you are is invisible and untouchable." In 2014, 99% Invisible began its fourth season, the first in which it had a weekly release schedule. As of 2024, show staff includes Executive Producer Kathy Tu; Design Director Kurt Kohlstedt; Senior Editor Delaney Hall; Director of Sound Swan Real; Senior Audio Engineer Martín Gonzalez; Supervising Producers Christopher Johnson and Vivan Le; as well as Producers Chris Berube, Emmett FitzGerald, Joe Rosenberg, and Lasha Madan as well associate producer Jeyca Medina Maldonado. Former staff include Sam Greenspan, Katie Mingle, Sharif Yousseff and Avery Trufelman.

Trufelman left to host "Articles of Interest," "Nice Try!" and "The Cut" podcasts.
